text: Give us real numbers isn't a spec. This video turns the discovery brief into acceptance criteria specific enough that anyone can check a finished bill against them.

Generation gets defined precisely: only readings from inside the billing month, never a reading flagged as degraded, and every single reading counted exactly once, no matter how many times it's captured or reprocessed.
That last rule has a name attached to it: re-run Harlan Voss's disputed month through the finished pipeline, and it has to come out to exactly $84.00.
Every criterion gets a verification method -- a reconciliation count, not a judgment call -- so delivery day is never an argument.
Next: drawing a hard line around what version one actually ships, before Desmond's real maintenance need expands the build.
